summary: Repointed T096's current-evidence references in Deliverables, Acceptance and References from T109 to T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence; preserved T109 as historical read-only predecessor; preserved the T109→T110→T111 chain reference as a compatibility and migration guarantee rather than a current-evidence path; kept T096 depends_on as [T073, T087, T088, T095, T097, T108, T111] (T112 is reachable transitively through T073/T087/T088/T108 per A0030/A0036/A0041/A0034 and through T110 per A0035); preserved the Must-not block byte-identical with no weakening; added a References sentence noting T112 is the current registry-bound source of manifest and paired simulation-evidence and T109 is preserved as historical read-only predecessor pending the SUPERSEDE amendment recorded by A0040. todo/config.yaml was not modified.
rationale: T112 is DELIVERED (APPROVED, replaces=[T109]) and is the documented current registry-bound product-run evidence source per A0026 impact A0026:T096:final-matrix-current-evidence. T096 is an indirect consumer of T109 (through T073, T087, T088, T108, T110, T111) rather than a direct consumer; T073, T087, T088 and T108 already bind T112 directly via A0030, A0036, A0041 and A0034 respectively, and T110 already binds T112 directly via A0035, so T096 inherits the T112 edge transitively through those existing contracts and does not need its own depends_on extension in todo/config.yaml. The Owner direction in amendment-request.json explicitly forbids editing todo/config.yaml for this amendment and explicitly forbids adding T112 to T096 Dependencies. The T096 contract therefore only swaps current-evidence language in Deliverables, Acceptance and References from T109 manifest / canonical-dataset manifest / canonical evidence to T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence; reframes the T109→T110→T111 chain reference from a current-evidence path to a compatibility and migration guarantee (the current evidence chain is now T112/T110/T111); marks pre-T112 T109/T105/T063/T069 records as historical read-only predecessor artifacts never parsed as current evidence; preserves the byte-identical Must-not block including its 'T109 manifest/evidence' authority-less reference (the predecessor reference is now fact and the byte-identical ban remains binding, with no weakening); and adds a References sentence noting T112 is the current registry-bound source of manifest and paired simulation-evidence this gate reads from and T109 is preserved only as a historical read-only predecessor pending the SUPERSEDE amendment recorded by A0040. No business code, no workflow state, no Intent/Spec, no plan-structure revision, no T069/T105/T063/T109/T110/T111/T112 contract, and no other task contract is touched.

impact_assessment.intent: Not applicable. PROJECT_GOALS.md and the broader docs/intent/ surface are unchanged. A0043 operates only on a still-PLANNED P09 task contract that was naming a downstream T1xx sibling (T109) as its current evidence source for the final V1 acceptance and traceability dossier. No product-intent question is reopened by repointing which T1xx sibling supplies T096's current evidence; every G-*, ADM-*, WEB-*, ECO-* and CTRL-* obligation still has to map to passing evidence or an explicit blocker, just as it already does under the existing registry-bound predecessors and the repaired T112 pipeline.
impact_assessment.specification: Not applicable. docs/spec/product/WEB_CONSOLE.md (the WEB-PAGE-012, WEB-PAGE-013 and WEB-GLOBAL-* spec pages T096 references), docs/spec/research/DATASET_AND_EVALUATION.md, docs/spec/strategy/STRATEGY_ECONOMICS.md, docs/spec/operations/OPERATOR_CONTROL.md, docs/spec/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md and the rest of docs/spec/ are unchanged. The current-evidence source naming in T096 is a contract-level binding, not a Spec statement. The Spec-level cutover from T109 to T112 was already recorded by the spec_revision v1-2026-09-23-a0026-run-evidence-cutover accompanying T112; the final dossier still has to read a current registry-bound manifest and paired simulation-evidence source as that Spec already requires.
impact_assessment.contracts: Applicable: todo/phases/P09-signer-testnet-and-live/T096.md is the only contract edited. Its Dependencies line remains 'T073, T087, T088, T095, T097, T108, T111' (no T112 edge is added in this amendment; T112 is reachable transitively through T073 (A0030), T087 (A0036), T088 (A0041) and T108 (A0034), and through T110 (A0035, reached from T111), per Owner direction). The Deliverables retarget: 'T109 is the current product-run and manifest/report/evidence authority' to 'T112 is the current registry-bound product-run and manifest/report/evidence authority'; 'T109's canonical-dataset manifest/report and simulation evidence' to 'T112's manifest and paired simulation-evidence'; 'no artifact of T109, T110, T111, T106 or T107' to 'no artifact of T112, T110, T111, T106 or T107'; 'T109 evidence, T110's MarketState, RunState and ReplayFrame' to 'T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence, T110's MarketState, RunState and ReplayFrame'; the named-deliveries list 'Each of T109, T110, T111, T106, T107 and T108' to 'Each of T112, T110, T111, T106, T107 and T108'; the predecessor records list 'a T069 run, T105/T063 manifest' to 'a T069 run, T105/T063 manifest, T109 manifest and paired simulation-evidence'; and the dependency closure list 'T110 and T109 through T111' to 'T112 through T073, T087, T088 and T108 (and through T110, reached from T111), as the current product-run and paired simulation-evidence authority; T110 and T109 through T111, with T109 the historical read-only predecessor manifest and evidence pending the SUPERSEDE amendment recorded by A0040'. The Acceptance retarget: 'the configured dependency closure of T096 contains T068, T069, T073, T087, T088, T097, T105, T106, T107, T108, T109, T110 and T111' to '... and T112'; 'distinguishes T109 as current from T069/T105 as predecessors' to 'distinguishes T112 as current from T069/T105/T109 as predecessors'; 'T109's canonical-dataset manifest, report and simulation evidence' to 'T112's manifest and paired simulation-evidence'; 'the T109/T110/T111 evidence chain' to 'the T112/T110/T111 evidence chain (with the T109→T110→T111 chain preserved as a compatibility and migration guarantee)'; 'absent or unapproved T109, T110 or T111 ... T069/T105 evidence exists' to 'absent or unapproved T112, T110 or T111 ... T069/T105/T109 evidence exists'; and 'no execution, approval, paper or live authority from a T109, T110, T111, T106 or T107 artifact' to '... a T112, T110, T111, T106 or T107 artifact'. The T109→T110→T111 chain reference is preserved as a compatibility and migration guarantee (Deliverables first paragraph) and as the historical predecessor chain whose properties are inherited by the T112/T110/T111 current evidence chain (Acceptance evidence-chain clause). The References retarget: the trailing task-list gains ', T112,' alongside the existing T109 entry; and a new References sentence is appended noting 'T112 is the current registry-bound source of manifest and paired simulation-evidence this gate reads from for the final matrix; T109 is preserved only as a historical read-only predecessor manifest and evidence pending the SUPERSEDE amendment recorded by A0040'. The Must-not block (lines 99-108 in the original / 105-115 in the candidate) is preserved byte-identical with no weakening; its 'T109 manifest/evidence ... no execution, approval, paper or live authority' ban and its 'T069/T105 predecessor evidence ... no task checkbox satisfy the replay goals' ban remain binding. No other task contract is touched (T069, T105, T063, T073, T084, T087, T088, T103, T107, T108, T110, T111, T109, T112 are unchanged).
impact_assessment.dependencies: Not applicable. todo/config.yaml is not modified by this amendment, per Owner direction. T096.depends_on remains [T073, T087, T088, T095, T097, T108, T111] (matches the contract's Dependencies line). T112 is reachable transitively from T096 through T073 (T073.depends_on already contains T112 per A0030), through T087 (T087.depends_on already contains T112 per A0036), through T088 (T088.depends_on already contains T112 per A0041), through T108 (T108.depends_on already contains T112 per A0034), and through T110 (T110.depends_on already contains T112 per A0035, reached from T096 → T111 → T110 → T112). The dependency DAG is not broken and no PLANNED direct consumer needs re-pointing for T096. The phase/active_task/workflow_state/intent_revision/spec_revision/agent_runtime top-level fields remain unchanged. No other task record's depends_on, replaces, superseded_by, lifecycle, claimed, attempt, base_commit, candidate_commit, approved_commit, latest_review or task_file field is touched.
impact_assessment.implementation: Not applicable. No business code is authored, modified, tested, reviewed or shipped. The T096 contract remains PLANNED with attempt=0 and no candidate or approved commit; no implementation gate is opened or closed. The Developer on a future T096 attempt will follow the updated contract and consume T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence through the transitive T073/T087/T088/T108 edges and through T110's ReplayFrame surface. The T109 contract's defective fixed-empty-source / fabricated-reference writer remains non-current for new runs under T112's runtime cutover clause and stays reachable only through the T069 entry for historical read-only / test fixture use, exactly as recorded by A0040 and the T112 review.
impact_assessment.data: Not applicable. No persisted artifact is created, modified, migrated, or reinterpreted. The amendment changes only which T1xx sibling T096 names as the current authority for the final V1 acceptance and traceability dossier; it does not move, copy, rewrite or relocate any manifest, report, simulation-evidence, dataset partition, dataset hash, run record, replay frame or review record on disk. Historical T069/T105/T063/T109 results and manifests stay byte-identical and read-only through the versioned legacy reader; only their rendering as historical is called out explicitly in the Deliverables pre-T112 clause.
impact_assessment.operations: Not applicable. No runtime surface, CLI command, background process, replay path, lifecycle hook, restart behaviour or live-process contract is touched. T112's runtime cutover remains gated by T112's atomic-publication clause and by the reviewed SUPERSEDE amendment that will annotate T109 superseded_by T112; this amendment neither enables that cutover nor alters the fail-closed behaviour T096's contract requires (an absent or non-validated evidence artifact already renders every G-*, ADM-*, WEB-*, ECO-* and CTRL-* obligation as the WEB-GLOBAL-002 unknown / fail-closed state with a named reason). Browser restart semantics, deployment, and any signer/testnet/live authority concerns remain out of scope.
impact_assessment.security: Not applicable. T096's read-only final dossier contract is unchanged in capability. No secret handling, authentication, signing, signer memory, keystore, wallet control, signing payload, endpoint secret, webhook credential, .env value or authorization-header surface is altered. The preserved byte-identical Must-not block continues to forbid granting execution, approval, paper or live authority; no T109 manifest/evidence, T110 replay frame, T111 adapter, T106 report or T107 candidate lock (and now no T112 manifest or paired simulation-evidence either, by extension of the same byte-identical ban) satisfies T094 or any execution, approval, paper or live gate. T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence carry no private key, signing payload, endpoint secret or credential by contract.
impact_assessment.verification: Applicable at the contract-and-config drift level only: this amendment edits exactly one contract file (T096.md) and does not touch todo/config.yaml, so the controller's drift check at finish-amendment will see the T096 Dependencies line ('T073, T087, T088, T095, T097, T108, T111') agree with todo/config.yaml's T096.depends_on field, with no T112 edge required in either surface for this amendment. No test, golden, fixture, oracle, tolerance or acceptance criterion is added, removed or relaxed; the existing T096 Acceptance clauses (the closure-contains-T068/T069/T073/T087/T088/T097/T105/T106/T107/T108/T109/T110/T111/and T112 assertion, the T112-as-current-vs-T069/T105/T109-as-predecessors distinction, the DS-005-DS-007/T104/T-22 evidence mapping, the per-delivery positive/negative/compatibility/migration/old-path-unreachable matrix, the T108 guide/example/drift-tests inclusion, the T112/T110/T111 evidence-chain A/B/C delayed-fill causality proof, creation-time cursor/ordinal agreement, T104 equivalence/provenance, consumer compatibility, atomic migration, canonical no-copy storage, no-strategy-callback-replay, no-post-sort-repair and predecessor-success-path-unreachable proofs, the predecessor-artifact/legacy-only/failed/cancelled/not-independently-approved fail-closed reasoning, the byte-identical historical retention, the absent/unapproved T112/T110/T111 fail-closed clause even if T069/T105/T109 evidence exists, and the no-permission/no-authority clause against a T112/T110/T111/T106/T107 artifact) remain the binding verification gate when T096 is eventually implemented. T096 itself does not re-test the T112 pipeline-repair invariants (real T100 partition resolution, block_range vs tick_range separation, fill-cursor preservation); those continue to be exercised by T112's own acceptance matrix.
